anomalies.observed: In the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block on the root sheet the two labels NET0007 and NET0010 are drawn side by side and their wires run into the same node at the left terminal of the 1 k series resistor R1 (the two nets are effectively merged). The 22 nF capacitor C12 sits between GND (top) and the touch-electrode node on the far side of R1 (A1 pin 1 'BTN'), i.e. the sampling capacitor is on the electrode, not on a separate TSC sampling IO.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification the two TSC group-2 IOs must be separate nets: TSC_G2_IO2 (PB5) - R8 1 kOhm - electrode BTN, and TSC_G2_IO4 (PB7) - C14 22 nF - GND, with the 22 nF sampling capacitor on the sampling IO net and no direct connection between the two IO nets.

evidence.quote: Capacitive Touch Button (TSC) block: labels NET0007 and NET0010 joined at the left of 'R1 1k', 'C12 22n' returned to GND and connected to 'A1 TSC' pin 1 (BTN) (root sheet, PCB.kicad_sch)
TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) - R8 (1 kOhm series resistor) - A2 pin "BTN" (the touch electrode); TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) - C14 (22 nF to GND) - this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group

anomalies.impact: The STM32 touch-sensing group 2 cannot make a valid measurement: the sampling capacitor is placed on the sense electrode instead of the sampling IO, and the two group IOs are shorted together through the shared node, so the capacitive button will not work.

anomalies.observed: On the DISPLAY sheet the SSD1306 interface-select pins are wired BS0 (pin 10) to the VCC rail and BS1 (pin 11) to GND (BS2, pin 12, to GND), i.e. the strapping is 1,0,0 rather than the I2C setting.
anomalies.expected: Specification: 'BS0 (pin 10) -> GND, BS1 (pin 11) -> VCC, BS2 (pin 12) -> GND', the SSD1306's documented I2C-mode pin configuration (BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0).

evidence.quote: DISPLAY sheet: BS0 (pin 10) wire routed up to the VCC symbol shared with R5/R9/R3, BS1 (pin 11) wire routed down to a GND symbol, BS2 (pin 12) to GND (display.kicad_sch)
BS0 (pin 10) -> GND; BS1 (pin 11) -> VCC; BS2 (pin 12) -> GND. That BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0 strapping ... is the SSD1306's documented I2C-mode pin configuration

anomalies.impact: The OLED module is strapped for a parallel/SPI interface instead of I2C, so the SSD1306 will ignore the MCU's I2C traffic on D0/D1/D2 and the display will stay blank.

parsed.summary: The build deviates from the specified design in two places: the capacitive-touch block merges the two TSC IO nets and puts the 22 nF sampling capacitor on the touch electrode instead of on the sampling IO, and the OLED module's BS0/BS1 interface-select pins are strapped to VCC/GND instead of the specified 0,1,0 I2C setting, which would take the display off the I2C bus.
